verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same encoding of the class as for eq-p077-3: one common growth degree p in place of the paper's separate b'_I and a'_I (reconciled by WeightedClasses.MemClass.of_separate_bounds), max 1 (delta x)⁻¹ in place of delta^{-1}, an abstract weight W in place of the envelope P(v) with the hypothesis envelope ≤ W, and ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j‖ for all j ≤ m in place of a single D^I. The exponent of epsilon is alpha, unchanged from the forcing hypothesis, exactly as in the paper. The paper's range of validity (0 ≤ v ≤ L_s between the cell endpoints) is the Lean side condition x ∈ s.domain together with x ∈ cells n k. ModalControl.localJets states the bound for the real copy solve; coefficients_jets states it for the complex amplitude assembled from the real and imaginary solves.
